script_text: Pisces, your ruling planet Neptune whispers through your 12th House this week, and the universe demands you finally listen. Monday and Tuesday bring the Sun's hard square to Saturn in Taurus from your 7th House, testing your patience in committed relationships. Venus feels the strain, so avoid confrontations Thursday. The major turning point arrives Wednesday when Venus enters your 7th House, igniting stunning new romantic energy in your partnership sector. Through the weekend, Venus trines Jupiter in Cancer in your 4th House, creating emotional abundance with a love connection that feels like destiny. Your career sees new opportunities expanding through your 9th House as Saturn supports growth. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 7th House, awakening love. Thursday is your worst day as Mercury squares Neptune, clouding communication. As a water sign, trust your intuition over logic now. Follow for daily updates.
